_meta.description: AML / cash-handling / bank-integrity rule-engine overlay. Adds the structured fields the AmlBankingChecks provider reads onto the existing GLTransaction (period state / electronic-payment support) and Account (trust/escrow segregation) schemas, and declares the new object types the bookkeeping core does not already model — CashTransaction, AmlReport, SanctionsScreening, CddRecord, FundsTransfer, TrustLedger and CashCount — so the cash-payment-limit, CTR/SAR/Form 8300, sanctions-screening, travel-rule, retention, cash-administration and trust-segregation rules in lib/Standards/rules/banking-aml.json become machine-checkable.

periodState.description: State of the accounting period this entry is posted to. A posted/reversed entry must not target a 'closed' period unless a controlled reopening is recorded (ledger-no-post-to-closed-period).

reopened.description: True when a controlled, logged reopening of an otherwise closed period authorised posting this correction (ledger-no-post-to-closed-period).

paymentMethod.description: Settlement method of the posting (e.g. cash, ideal, sepa, card, wire). Electronic payment methods require a supporting bank/payment-service record (ledger-electronic-payment-records).

paymentReference.description: Bank / payment-service reference supporting an electronic payment posting (ledger-electronic-payment-records).

counterparty.description: The counterparty of an electronic payment posting (ledger-electronic-payment-records).

valueDate.description: Value date of an electronic payment posting per the bank/payment-service record (ledger-electronic-payment-records).

accountType.description: Classification of the account (e.g. bank, cash, trust, escrow, iolta, derdengelden). A trust/escrow account is subject to the segregation rules.

isTrustAccount.description: True when this Account holds third-party client monies (derdengelden / trust / IOLTA / escrow). Such an account must be segregated and never commingled (nl-derdengelden-segregation, us-iolta-escrow-segregation).

segregated.description: True when a trust/escrow account is held as a separate account, distinct from the firm's own funds (nl-derdengelden-segregation, us-iolta-escrow-segregation).

commingled.description: True when client monies are commingled with the firm's own funds — a violation for a trust/escrow account (nl-derdengelden-segregation, us-iolta-escrow-segregation).

CashTransaction.title: Cash Transaction (AML)
CashTransaction.description: A cash payment received or made, modelled so the cash-payment-limit, customer-due-diligence-threshold and US Form 8300 cash-reporting rules can be machine-checked against its amount, parties and payment method.

administrationId.description: The administration / legal entity the cash transaction belongs to.

transactionDate.description: Date the cash payment was received or made.

amount.description: Cash amount of the single transaction.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the amount.

partyCapacity.description: Whether at least one party acts in a professional capacity (the cash-limit applies) or both act privately (EU exemption).

paymentMethod.description: Payment method; 'cash' for the cash-limit rules.

appliedCashLimit.description: The effective national/EU cash-payment ceiling applied to this transaction (must be no looser than the EUR 10 000 EU ceiling).

cddPerformed.description: True when customer due diligence was performed (required at or above the applicable CDD threshold).

goodsCategory.description: Category of goods/services; 'precious-metals' triggers the lower DE EUR 2 000 CDD threshold.

linkedTransactionsTotal.description: Combined amount of linked operations, used to test the limit/threshold against the transaction as a whole.

aggregate12mTotal.description: Aggregate of related cash payments from the same payer within a 12-month period (US Form 8300 related-transactions).

form8300Required.description: True when a Form 8300 was filed for this (or the related-transaction aggregate) cash receipt over USD 10 000.

AmlReport.title: AML Report (CTR / SAR / 8300 / CMIR / FBAR / unusual)
AmlReport.description: A currency- / suspicious- / large-cash-transaction report, modelled so its threshold, filing-window, same-day-aggregation, payer-statement and retention obligations can be machine-checked.

administrationId.description: The administration / legal entity the report belongs to.

thresholdAmount.description: The reporting threshold that applies to this report type.

transactionDate.description: Date of the reportable transaction (CTR / 8300 filing-window and payer-statement reference).

detectionDate.description: Date of initial detection of the facts (SAR filing-window reference).

eFiled.description: True when the report was filed electronically (CTR BSA E-Filing).

sameDayAggregate.description: Same-business-day aggregate of currency transactions by/for one person (CTR aggregation).

payerStatementDate.description: Date the written payer statement was furnished (Form 8300; must be by 31 January of the year after the transaction).

retentionUntil.description: Date until which the report and its supporting data are retained (at least five years after filedDate; NL Wwft report-retention).

SanctionsScreening.title: Sanctions Screening (OFAC / EU / national)
SanctionsScreening.description: A sanctions-list screening of a customer/UBO or transaction, modelled so the screening-before-transaction, OFAC SDN-list and match-reporting obligations can be machine-checked.

administrationId.description: The administration / legal entity the screening belongs to.

screenedDate.description: Date the screening was performed (must be on or before the transaction date).

transactionDate.description: Date of the transaction/relationship the screening guards.

listName.description: Primary sanctions list screened against (e.g. OFAC-SDN, EU-CFSP, NL-Sanctiewet).

listsScreened.description: All sanctions lists screened against (must include OFAC SDN for the US rule).

matched.description: True when the subject matched a sanctioned party.

reportedDate.description: Date a match was reported to the supervisor/OFAC (required when matched).

CddRecord.title: Customer Due Diligence Record
CddRecord.description: A customer-due-diligence record, modelled so the occasional-transaction CDD threshold, the UBO 25% ownership test and the five-year retention obligation can be machine-checked.

administrationId.description: The administration / legal entity the record belongs to.

customerId.description: The customer the CDD record concerns.

performed.description: True when CDD was performed (required at or above the threshold).

transactionAmount.description: Amount of the occasional transaction the CDD concerns.

uboOwnershipPct.description: Ownership / voting-rights percentage of the identified beneficial owner.

uboIdentified.description: True when a beneficial owner at or above the 25% threshold has been identified.

recordedDate.description: Date the CDD record was created (retention reference).

retentionUntil.description: Date until which the CDD record is retained (at least five years after recordedDate).

FundsTransfer.title: Funds Transfer (travel rule)
FundsTransfer.description: A transfer of funds, modelled so the travel-rule obligation that payer and payee information accompanies the transfer can be machine-checked.

administrationId.description: The administration / legal entity the transfer belongs to.

TrustLedger.title: Trust / Escrow Ledger
TrustLedger.description: A pooled trust/escrow account ledger with per-client balances, modelled so the no-overdraw rule (no client funded with another client's money) can be machine-checked.

administrationId.description: The administration / legal entity the trust ledger belongs to.

segregated.description: True when the pooled account is segregated from the firm's own funds.

asOfDate.description: Date the per-client balances are stated as of.

clientBalances.description: Per-client balances within the pooled account; none may be negative.

clientId.description: The client the balance belongs to.

balance.description: The client's balance within the pooled account.

CashCount.title: Cash Count (kasadministratie / Z-report)
CashCount.description: A periodic physical cash count, modelled so the count-to-cash-book reconciliation, non-negative running balance and daily Z-report reconciliation can be machine-checked.

administrationId.description: The administration / legal entity the cash count belongs to.

countDate.description: Date of the physical cash count.

bookBalance.description: Cash-book (kasadministratie) balance the count reconciles to.

runningBalance.description: Running cash-account balance (must never be negative).

recordedTakings.description: Recorded cash takings the Z-report total reconciles to.
